snapback-selfheal 1.8.0

- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for clearer guidance on free vs metered tools and detailed infra error handling.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Minor tweaks to configuration for improved clarity and accuracy.

snapback-selfheal 1.7.0

- Expanded documentation with more detailed usage instructions, tool descriptions, and troubleshooting examples.
- Now highlights live, mid-run guardians (detect_loop, budget_guard, live step-by-step monitoring).
- Clarifies free vs metered tool access and introduces pay-per-call x402 payment support (Solana/EVM).
- Includes an overview table for all tools, triggers, and authorization requirements.
- Adds detailed descriptions for diagnosing infrastructure errors instantly across 46 failure families.
